verdict.rationale: Extend is clearly API-first: it ships a documented REST API, SDKs, CLI, and both a docs MCP and an OAuth-protected hosted MCP server, and the API quickstart plus llms.txt explicitly targets AI agents. However, the evidence never confirms that UI-only workspace features like Studio, Workflows, and Composer & Review Agent (listed as pricing tiers) are fully configurable/operable via the API rather than just triggered by it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Studio/Workflow/Composer configuration and review steps are achievable through the API, and any independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
